verdict.rationale: A probe found a live llms.txt on NVIDIA's developer portal, which hosts the CUDA Toolkit docs for programming this GPU, so an agent has an agent-oriented entry point into the product's developer documentation. That file is portal-wide rather than RTX 5080-specific, and the markdown version of the CUDA toolkit page returned 404, so per-page agent-readable docs are not shown. Missing for 10: RTX 5080/GeForce-specific agent-oriented docs, markdown versions of doc pages, evidence of llms.txt content depth or coverage, and hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
